error_space.note: All custom errors of the program share one Anchor error space starting at 6000. The ordinals are assigned per enum in the recovered source: MayhemError declares 0, 1, 2 explicitly and then 14, 16, 17; the trade-family enums (SellError, BuyError, BurnError, PumpSwapError) fill the intervening ordinals. pub enum MayhemError {
    #[msg("Trading is paused")]

}
